name: Classical Myth in Art
homeDescription: A study guide to Greek and Roman myth in art: sixty paintings, sculptures and vases, each with the story of the object itself and the myth it shows.
ldDescription: Greek and Roman myths told through sixty paintings, sculptures and vases, each with the story of the object itself.
